reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, brand, launch_date
FROM products
WHERE (brand = 'Sonora' OR brand = 'Echoline') AND launch_date >= '2024-04-01'
alternatives:

FROM products
WHERE launch_date >= '2024-04-01' AND (brand = 'Echoline' OR brand = 'Sonora')

SELECT product_id, product_name, brand, launch_date
FROM products
WHERE (brand = 'Sonora' AND launch_date >= '2024-04-01') OR (brand = 'Echoline' AND launch_date >= '2024-04-01')

SELECT product_id, product_name, brand, launch_date
FROM products
WHERE (brand = 'Sonora' OR brand = 'Echoline') AND NOT launch_date < '2024-04-01'
